prompt: Name an element whose chemical symbol is a single letter.

answers.name: Oxygen
answers.fact: O. Nearly half the mass of the Earth's crust.

answers.name: Carbon
answers.fact: C. The basis of every known form of life.

answers.name: Hydrogen
answers.fact: H. About ninety percent of all the atoms in the universe.

answers.name: Nitrogen
answers.fact: N. Seventy-eight percent of the air you are breathing.

answers.name: Sulfur
answers.fact: S. Known since antiquity as brimstone.

answers.name: Phosphorus
answers.fact: P. Isolated from urine in 1669 by an alchemist hunting for gold.

answers.name: Fluorine
answers.fact: F. The most reactive element there is.

answers.name: Boron
answers.fact: B. What makes borosilicate glass survive the oven.

answers.name: Iodine
answers.fact: I. Named from the Greek for violet, after the colour of its vapour.

answers.name: Uranium
answers.fact: U. Named for the planet Uranus, discovered eight years earlier.

answers.name: Tungsten
answers.fact: W, from wolfram. The highest melting point of any metal.

answers.name: Vanadium
answers.fact: V. Named for Vanadis, a name of the Norse goddess Freyja.

answers.name: Yttrium
answers.fact: Y. Named after Ytterby, a Swedish village that gave its name to four elements.
